## Featured Projects

- [Atlas — Autonomous AI GitHub Copilot & Code Intelligence Cockpit](https://atlas.karthicka.me): Autonomous AI code reviewer that connects via GitHub App OAuth, audits codebases for race conditions and vulnerabilities using LangGraph 3-node state graphs and MCP tools, and generates surgical 1-click pull request patches. Built with Python 3.13, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, React 19, and Turso libSQL.
- [Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Service](https://github.com/akarthick-dev/Retrieval-Augmented-Generation): Production-grade document question-answering microservice. Ingests raw documentation, embeds with dense vectors into ChromaDB, and generates factually verified answers with source citations using FastAPI and typed Pydantic schemas.
- [Sana — Real-Time Voice AI Companion](https://sana.karthicka.me): Shipped, live voice-enabled AI companion holding persistent contextual memory across multi-turn sessions. Built with Python prompt orchestration, faster-whisper, Groq inference, and ElevenLabs streaming speech synthesis.
